Helpers to build the core subtopology and permit links with no producers or consumers.

# Purpose
Defines helper routines for building a small Firedancer development sub-topology. The [`fd_core_subtopo`](<#fd_core_subtopo>) function adds the `metric`, `net`, and `sign` tiles, sets their workspace and link setup, and copies configuration values such as the Prometheus listen address, gossip port, and identity key path into the new tiles. It also checks that the tiles do not already exist and uses `fd_topos_net_tiles` to create the network tiles before it attaches the sign tiles. The [`fd_link_permit_no_producers`](<#fd_link_permit_no_producers>) and [`fd_link_permit_no_consumers`](<#fd_link_permit_no_consumers>) helpers mark named links so that topology checks allow links with no producers or no consumers, which is useful for development and test sub-topologies.
